title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-28

ai_review.summary: Decent audience recording of a classic Summer ’73 show with mixed sound quality but solid 1973 Dead vibes.
ai_review.review: The crowd‑sourced tape captures the legendary summer jam atmosphere, though the audio fluctuates and is only fair in clarity. Musically the concert is described as a typical 1973 set that’s enjoyable if not among the band’s very best performances.

ai_rating.rationale: Four reviews give an average rating of ~3.8; reviewers note decent performance but mixed recording quality, leading to a solid but not outstanding overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio fluxes in places with occasional clear moments; typical audience bleed and inconsistency expected from a crowd recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical mid‑summer 1973 Dead set—soundcheck praised, main concert considered respectable but not a standout compared to other shows that summer.
